quote: The copious results achieved so far on more than 10 compounds, joined with the preliminary results from the CUORE background model (Sec. 7), indicate that the optimal choice for CUPID is lithium molybdate (Li2MoO4)

Germanium wafers instrumented with NTDs are one of the most well-established technologies for the detection of scintillation light in cryogenic experiments [36, 83, 84]. The NTD readout of the LDs allows us to take advantage of the electronics and the wiring system already implemented in CUORE.
